    AI Overview
    The 2026 Masters Tournament tournament rounds (Thursday-Friday) begin with the first tee time at approximately 7:40 a.m. ET, following the 7:30 a.m. Honorary Starters ceremony. Featured group coverage starts earlier at 9:15-9:55 a.m. ET, with TV coverage on ESPN from 3-7:30 p.m. ET. Weekend coverage (Saturday-Sunday) starts around noon on Paramount+ and 2 p.m. on CBS. 
    Key 2026 Masters Start Times (EDT): 
    • Honorary Starters: 7:30 a.m. on Thursday.
    • First Tee Times: Approximately 7:40 a.m. Thursday/Friday.
    • Featured Groups (Streaming): 9:55 a.m. - 7:30 p.m. (Friday).
    • TV Coverage (ESPN): 3:00 p.m. - 7:30 p.m. (Thursday/Friday).
    • TV Coverage (CBS): 2:00 p.m. - 7:00 p.m. (Saturday/Sunday). 
    Note: All times are subject to weather delays, and it is recommended to check the official Masters.com leaderboard for the most up-to-date pairings.
